request_state.conjecture: Beal conjecture: A^x + B^y = C^z with x,y,z >= 3 has no coprime solutions. Descent on (3,3,3) in Lean 4 Euler.lean has 123 machine-checked theorems. We investigate closing the descent termination induction on N and evaluating the Darmon motivic obstruction.

candidate.claim: CYCLOTOMIC UNIT INTEGRALITY AND CUBE FACTORIZATION IN Z[omega]: Formalizing the step from three_pid to CubeFormParam by factoring p^2 + 3q^2 = (p + q sqrt(-3))(p - q sqrt(-3)) in the PID Z[omega].
candidate.text: In Z[omega], the unit group has order 6 (units are +-1, +-omega, +-omega^2). Because 3 is odd, every unit cube is +-1. This allows extracting a cube up to sign.
